svg.title: Drawdown order and shortfall wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / SETTINGS / DRAWDOWN
Order is a plan setting used by the engine.
Early withdrawals before the allowed age include the penalty in the result.
Drag to reorder. The saved order is used by the engine on the next run.
Withdrawals sum to the need. Any gap becomes a shortfall.
The result records a shortfall and a warning. It never shows
Default order is cash, taxable, tax-deferred, tax-free. The stored setting drives every run.
For a $50,000 need, cash supplies $18,000 and taxable supplies the remaining $32,000. Ending balances reconcile with
Penalties for withdrawals before the allowed age are included in the year's tax result, not netted silently.
Insufficient assets produce a shortfall record and a warning with the year. No negative balance is ever displayed.
